# PMI PM Input-Output Crosswalk

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Covers every named input, output, and project artifact in PMBOK Guide 8th Edition, Section 4 "Inputs and Outputs" (lines 8929-10457). Terms appear in alphabetical order as in the source.

## Legend

| Treatment | Meaning |
|-----------|---------|
| **Catalog**  -  PM-xx | Article is an actionable project artifact. Existing ID or proposed new ID. |
| **Alias → PM-xx** | Different PMBOK name for a concept already in the catalog. |
| **Part of PM-xx** | Content belongs inside the specified catalog artifact container. |
| **Context input** | EEF/OPA  -  influences the project, is not a project-managed artifact. |
| **Lifecycle state** | An update or version of another artifact, not a standalone item. |
| **Outcome** | Emergent result, not prescribed as a maintainable artifact. |
| **Generic container** | Catch-all category (e.g. "project documents"). |
| **Technique** | Tool or method, not an artifact. |
| **Meta concept** | Foundational PM term, not an artifact to prescribe. |
